function.name: lookup_by_claim_number
function.description: Resolves a warranty claim number OR ServicePower dispatch number to the matching job in our system. Always your first tool call when a CSC rep gives you a number. Returns the job, customer name + phone, assigned tech (if any), and warranty company. If match_count is 0, the number may have been misheard — read it back digit-by-digit before saying we have no record.

claim_or_dispatch_number.description: The claim or dispatch number the CSC rep gave you. Strip spaces. Examples: '49135689' (AHS), 'SP-2024-00123' (ServicePower).
